{{Quote|Star Tours, follow us down to the rebel hangar! You'll be safe there.|[[Unidentified N-1 starfighter pilot (Star Tours)|Naboo Rebel pilot]] to Star Tours flight|<ref name="Star Tours: The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>}}
A '''hangar''' was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
During a battle between Rebel-affiliated [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] and an opposing force of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class starfighters]] and [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleships]], a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[StarSpeeder 1000]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] into the battlefield. The N-1s escorted the vessel down to the planet, guiding it to the hangar, but were ambushed by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] fighters along the way. After a hazardous journey through the planet's core, the StarSpeeder 1000 emerged in front of the hangar, crash-landing inside of it and was impaled on the end of a N-1's tail section.
